title: Lock & Roll to cast spells! Seferia Matrix has been officially released!
author: BeyondAffinity
selftext:
**Seferia: Matrix** is a dice roguelike deckbuilder. Lock and roll five dice into Yahtzee-style hands to cast spells, then stack 300+ upgrades until the damage explodes.

**How it plays**

* Roll five dice, lock the ones you want, reroll the rest, and cast the spell your hand matches.
* Combine 100+ Artifacts and dozens of Sigils to build a mage that's entirely your own.
* Even when a run fails, your effort carries over as permanent upgrades.

**Three schools, two classes**

Enroll at a magic academy and pick a school: Arcana, Nihila or Materia. Mages fight with spells; Battle Mages are a hybrid class that blends melee attacks with magic. That makes six modes, each with eight difficulty levels.

As of today, there's a 15% launch discount, and it's currently in a bundle with Slotbound, the indie game that's been getting a lot of buzz lately — please check it out!  
The full version (with Battle Mage modes and monthly rankings) is out now on Steam: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/4515500/Seferia\_Matrix/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4515500/Seferia_Matrix/)

**AI disclaimer.**  
An LLM-centered development pipeline was a huge help in making this game. Especially in order to craft and stylized its artworks to compensate for the budget\*.\* There are many, many opinions about using AI, but personally, after making this game single-handedly while wrestling with AI, I'm excited that today's already impressive AI development environment will produce even better results going forward. At the same time, with so many games coming out these days thanks to AI, just like mine, I'm cheering on all indie developers. Keep going..!
